_readme: Questions for series with host videos. Asked only when the series writes "checklist": {"packs": ["host"]} in series.json.

rules.ask: Which image is this episode's final host image? Do the framing, gestures and expression follow the series rules? Has it been uploaded to the service that makes the host videos?
After timing and before sending to the host service, have you listened to every word whose pronunciation you changed yourself?
